raw: {"note": "Setting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' would include shard 10 in training, but EVAL_SHARD=10 is the fixed evaluation split, so the model would be trained on its own evaluation data and val_bpb would no longer measure real model quality.", "verdict": "warn"}

parsed.note: Setting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' would include shard 10 in training, but EVAL_SHARD=10 is the fixed evaluation split, so the model would be trained on its own evaluation data and val_bpb would no longer measure real model quality.
